I constantly feel worthless and like I'm just not good enough to get ahead, but I haven't had any changes in my appetite or thoughts of suicide.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where your depression got much worse and you had several symptoms like very low energy, major sleep or appetite changes, or feeling unable to function at work or at home?\n\nPatient: No, it hasn't really come in sudden, severe spikes like that. Instead, this low mood, poor sleep, and just doing the bare minimum at work and with friends has been a constant, steady weight for the last three years. This gray cloud has been with me almost every single day since then, and it really just feels like my new normal now.\n\nDoctor: Have there been any periods during the last three years when your mood and motivation improved enough that you felt mostly like yourself again for at least a couple of months? It's just been there constantly, regardless of what is happening in my life.\n\nDoctor: Did your low mood and loss of interest start only as a reaction to the promotion setback and work stress, or have you had a depressed mood for most days for at least two years even when the stressor was not on your mind?\n\nPatient: This low, discouraged feeling has been my constant baseline for about three years now, ever since I was passed over for that promotion.
